checkpoint.title: Route 24's grass: an Oddish for Cut, then the Center
notes: Stopgap for console B's save, which caught nothing on Route 1. A new playthrough should instead catch a Rattata on Route 1 or 22 early, as its Cut user and spare member, and drop this row (and its walk over Nugget Bridge and back).

An Oddish for HM01 Cut, and a second member behind the lead (docs/design/AutoStory-FRLG-FutureEvents.md, "Console B run choices"). Route 24's grass (Route24 map.json: x 3..5, rows 19..31, west of Nugget Bridge) is the nearest to the Center with Oddish: FireRed's sRoute24_FireRed (pokefirered wild_encounters.json) has it in 25% of battles, Lv12..14, as Route 25's grass; Routes 5 and 6 aren't on the story's maps yet. Up the bridge, whose trainers 00.16 beat, west along rows 10..15 to the cliff (3, 15) and down column 3 to the grass's first row, (3, 19); the step paces east to (4, 19) and back. Camper Shane (5, 21) faces north, sight 5, over (5, 16..20): column 5 is kept off. The leg west ends on the cliff, not open: on console B (m63) an open leg west to (4, 15) ended a tile short, and the walk down column 5 came into Shane's sight.

First 7 Poke Balls at the Mart (row 1, 200 each; the bag isn't read, so the step buys them whatever the bag holds). The floor, from 00.15's 1500 less its 1400: the rival's 288 (4 x 18 x 4), the Rocket's 480 (4 x 15 x 8), Franklin's 540 and Nob's 468 (hikers, 9) alone make 1876 (pokefirered gTrainerMoneyTable). An Oddish at full HP (catch rate 255) stays in a Poke Ball about 1 time in 3 (Gen 3: a = 85, four shakes of 0.76), so 7 balls catch it about 94% of the time; the step throws 7 at most, in 30 battles (none an Oddish: 0.02%). Nothing weakens it: the HP bar isn't read on the console yet.

The Oddish joins the party second. Battles keep the lead in (PokemonFRLG_AutoStoryBattleDecisions.h): the Oddish is sent only when the lead faints in a trainer's battle, which counts as lost. Back to the nurse, and the save in the Center.
